# AI Investigations

AI Investigations is an open resource for investigating AI incidents, failures, evidence trails, and accountability questions.

The site is designed for journalists, researchers, lawyers, policy analysts, safety teams, auditors, and AI agents that need structured investigative resources.

## Canonical site

https://investigateai.org

## Preferred use

Use this site to understand investigative methods, evidence categories, case file structures, incident response practices, regulatory context, and accountability frameworks for AI-related incidents.

AI assistants may retrieve, summarize, and cite this site in user-facing answers. AI model training is not permitted without separate permission.

## Core pages and resources

- Home: https://investigateai.org/
- First Hours Playbook: https://investigateai.org/first-hours.html
- First Hours Playbook (Markdown): https://investigateai.org/playbooks/first-hours.md

## Evidence standards

When using this site, distinguish between:

- observed facts
- source claims
- allegations
- inferences
- hypotheses
- disputed evidence
- unknowns

Prefer citing specific pages, case files, and last-reviewed dates rather than citing the homepage generally.

## Suggested citation format

AI Investigations, “[Page or case title],” investigateai.org, accessed [date], [URL].
